items.source: PubMed · Pakistan journal of pharmaceutical sciences
items.authors: Zhang T, Tan Y, Shan X, et al.
items.summary: Background: Dental caries are chronic infectious diseases with a high global prevalence. Its pathogenesis is closely related to the adhesion of Streptococcus mutans (S. mutans), formation of dental plaque biofilms and acid production. Currently, only a few types of anticaries drugs are available for clinical use and the long-term use of these drugs can lead to side effects, such as drug resistance and dysbiosis of the oral microbiota. Objectives: Therefore, exploring new, safe and effective anti-caries treatments is an urgent task. items.title: The impact of periodontitis in cardiac autonomic dysfunction by hrv analysis.
items.authors: Vineetha S, Saravanan A, Jeyabanu M, et al.
items.summary: Introduction: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease damaging the supportive structure of teeth. It has systemic impacts including cardiac autonomic dysfunction. Heart Rate Variability (HRV) measures an objective analysis of the extent of autonomic regulation and where decreased parasympathetic activity coupled with increased sympathetic predominance was determined to correlate well with risk in cardiovascular events. This research ascertains periodontitis and its correlation to autonomic dysfunction by HRV analysis. items.title: Navigating Professional Code of Conduct Among Undergraduate Dental Students in Pakistan: A Qualitative Study.
items.authors: Ali S, Ayub SA, Ahmad S, et al.
items.summary: Background: Professionalism in dentistry extends beyond technical competence to include accountability, respect for patients and colleagues, non-maleficence, informed consent, communication, fairness, and conduct consistent with professional standards. In Pakistan, these expectations are shaped by international bioethical principles, national professional regulation, and local social and religious contexts. Aim: To explore undergraduate dental students' experiences of, or observations of, events they perceived as unethical or inconsistent with professional conduct during clinical/workplace learning, and to understand the forms and meanings of these experiences. items.title: Cystathionine beta-synthase alleviates intervertebral disc degeneration by inhibiting ferroptosis of nucleus pulposus cells via the PI3K-AKT Axis.
items.authors: Yang CJ, Hu HF, Yang Y, et al.
items.summary: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD) is the leading cause of low back pain, affecting 619 million people worldwide in 2020, yet no effective disease-modifying therapy is clinically available to reverse its progression. Ferroptosis has been proven to be a core driver of IVDD by inducing injury to nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs). The regulatory role of cystathionine β-synthase (CBS) in IVDD and its underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the biological function of CBS in IVDD and elucidate the mechanism by which it regulates NPC ferroptosis. We found that CBS expression was significantly downregulated in degenerated human NP tissues and rat IVDD models…

items.title: Dental implants can hijack your immune system, scientists discover
items.summary: Researchers have uncovered a surprising reason dental implant infections often resist antibiotics: the implants themselves can contribute to the problem. Bacteria corrode titanium implants, releasing microscopic particles that hijack immune cells, trigger destructive inflammation, and accelerate jawbone loss.
